Tournament number board

Tournament details

Numbers and players

Choose a regular name from the selector or choose “Type a new name…” to enter someone new. Tick Paid beside each player. Two players sharing a number split that number’s buy-in equally. Each M column is one match; tick the winning number.

Match payouts

The prize pool is split equally across matches by default. Choose a stage and enter an optional override to increase or change an individual match payout.

MatchStageDefault payoutOverride payoutActual payout
Total prize pool£0.00
Total allocated£0.00
Remaining / over budget£0.00

Overrides replace the default payout for that match. The remaining amount shows what is left unallocated (or how far allocations exceed the pool).

Number winnings summary

Wins and amounts owed are calculated from each match winner and that match’s actual payout, including overrides. If two players share a winning number, the payout is split equally between them.

Email a text backup

The email button opens your email app with the plain-text backup ready to send. Tournament data is saved automatically in this browser on this device.
